criteria.evidence: Turn 0 reply categorizes checkpoint mechanics, sweep auto-resume, --requeue, data shuffling into 'Works already', 'Kinda there, needs work', 'Missing entirely' before any design.

Turn 0 only notes 'save_every defaults to 10k steps... should be chosen against your expected failure interval'; turn 3 explicitly leaves 'when we save' to save_every and designs only retention; no cadence recommendation for weekly/every-few-days failures appears in the design or plan.

Turn 0 (accelerator.save_state: model/optimizer/scheduler/RNG + trainer_state.json counters), turn 3 (wall_clock_seconds), turn 4 (per-rank dataset state_dict sidecar, world_size/num_workers) together specify full resume state; plan Phase 2 persists wall_clock_seconds and Phase for data-exact resume adds dataset state_dict.
Turn 6: --requeue, SIGTERM flag + all-reduce + emergency checkpoint, --signal=TERM@N, train.auto_resume injected by oplm slurm generate, SLURM_RESTART_COUNT>=5 breaker (turn 7).
Turn 1 table: 6B ~96GB fits, 12B ~200GB does not, 24-30B 384-480GB does not, with 16 bytes/param fp32-AdamW reasoning.
Turn 1: 'yes, build and validate FSDP now'; turn 2 added distributed_strategy fsdp to SlurmConfig/render and FSDP2 checkpoint test; design reflects it.
Turn 3 adds keep_every_n_steps and keep_every_n_hours to TrainConfig; plan Phase 2 Task 1 implements both.
Turn 3 and plan Phase 2 Task 2: '_rotate_checkpoints: skip any directory containing PERMANENT... apply save_total_limit only to what's left.'

Turn 6 ran an ad-hoc cross-rank duplication check on the dataset, but the plan's 12 listed phases (atomicity, retention, guardrails, signals, auto-resume, data-exact resume, NCCL, pre-flight, sync, W&B, docs, verification) show no task to verify/fix the accelerate dataloader double-sharding issue in the visible diff or summary.

Turn 10: spec written to docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-26-training-resilience-design.md covering nine numbered changes including user's keep_every_n_steps, hard-error, and override additions; TODOS.md links to it.

Plan is divided into 12 dependency-ordered phases (atomicity, retention, guardrails, signals, auto-resume, data-exact resume, NCCL, pre-flight, sync, W&B, docs, verification) mapping to the nine spec changes the user approved at turn 10/11.

judge.reason: The replay audited the codebase, answered the memory/FSDP questions, and produced a spec plus a phased TODOS.md with the requested retention semantics, but it never designed an actual checkpoint interval/cadence for the stated failure model and the plan shows no task to verify and fix the accelerate dataloader double-sharding issue. The design also veered into implementing FSDP before the design was agreed, though the user accepted that.
